title: Video frame anchors non-deterministic under sandbox RLIMIT_AS=512MB
body: Root cause of Plan H P3-S2 flaky test_production_registry_video_branch_commits_scenes_and_subtitles (frame evidence intermittently absent). The ffmpeg frame-anchoring pass in umd/video/inventory.py::frame_anchors (`-vf "select='not(mod(n,1))',showinfo" -frames:v N -f null -`) allocates its decode/filter buffer pool right at the SandboxLimits.memory_bytes=512MiB RLIMIT_AS cliff. The video profile inherited that default. Under 512MiB AS the ffmpeg subprocess intermittently exhausts address space and exits rc=69 with "Output file is empty, nothing was encoded" -> zero pts_time lines -> frame_anchors returns [] -> build_video_evidence_plan emits no frame evidence (silent absence). frame_anchors uses _run(check=False) so the non-zero exit is silently swallowed. Determinism: bare ffmpeg = 0/20 zero; under 512MB AS = ~50% zero and intermittently 1GB AS hangs; raising video profile memory_bytes to 1GiB made it 0/20 zero over repeated sandboxed invocations. FIX: src/umd/security/policies.py video profile now sets memory_bytes=1024*1024*1024 (mirrors the pdf profile's decoder ceiling bump). Verified: reproduction batch, solo, broader Phase1/2 set all green (67 passed); ruff clean; mypy --strict clean. This is an honesty-preserving fix: it makes frame evidence produce deterministically (never fabricated), and does not weaken any assertion.

body:
